summary: Frontend-only testing of the Ahorramix Shopify theme local preview (liquidjs rendered at http://127.0.0.1:8095). Executed critical visual + interactive checks on index.html (1440px and 390px), product.html and collection.html (390px). All required interactions (announcement rotation, dept panel desktop, mobile drawer, offer carousel next/prev/dots, tabs, gallery, qty +/-, add to cart presence, discount badges, 2-col collection grid) work correctly. No JS console errors. Logo renders (naturalWidth=640). Cart counter shows 2. Hero title 'Ahorra más en todo lo que te gusta.' present (broken across lines, by design). [data-hero-toggle] correctly absent (no video). Vendor info 'Ahorramix · Y0447650S' present in footer. No visible horizontal overflow (body uses overflow-x:clip; a 15px/5px theoretical excess from off-screen carousel slides is clipped and not scrollable).

issues: document.scrollWidth exceeds clientWidth by 15px (desktop) / 5px (mobile) because off-screen .offer slides are positioned outside .offers__main — currently hidden only by body { overflow-x: clip }. Not a visible scroll, but a stricter fix would be to ensure .offers__track also has overflow:hidden. Low priority.

critical_code_review_comments: theme.js initProduct uses .gallery__slide + is-active toggling (correct approach, works).
Carousel autoplay set via data-autoplay (times:1000). Works. Dots/next/prev all functional.
Announcement bar rotates .announce__msg.is-active ~every 4s — verified visually (msg0 -> msg1 after 4.5s).

Mobile drawer has both an overlay AND a close button sharing [data-drawer-close]. In Playwright the overlay element appears first and is intercepted by the panel subtree — Escape and the X button work fine; just a note that automated tests should target button[data-drawer-close] specifically.
Dept panel uses position:absolute inside header; closes on Escape and outside-click correctly.
collection.html uses .rail.rail--grid with grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr → 2-col grid at 390px as required.
Hero height var --hero-h:82svh; may cause excess scroll on some mobile browsers but acceptable.
All required Spanish copy present: 'Explora por categoría', 'Ofertas del día', 'Compra por departamento', 'Productos destacados', 'Ahorra más en todo lo que te gusta.', 'Ahorramix · Y0447650S'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview server at http://127.0.0.1:8095 (python http.server over /root/tc/out). Theme sources at /app/shopify/ahorramix-theme. Validated: desktop dept panel, mobile drawer (X button has button[data-drawer-close], overlay also has data-drawer-close), carousel next/prev/dots change slides, tabs toggle aria-selected, product gallery uses .gallery__slide.is-active, qty uses [data-qty='1'|'-1'] with min=1, hero-toggle correctly absent when no video. No JS console errors.
